authority.provenance: Derived by generate.mjs, in this directory, from current-profile-01 and the current-profile-02 overlay under the operator ruling of 2026-10-22. No engine output is read; current-profile-01, the current-profile-02 and current-profile-03 overlays, early-corpus.json and mesh-entry.json stay byte-identical.
authority.reason: Profile 01 and the current-profile-02 overlay pinned a malformed claim expectation as an invalid-claim rejection of the whole plan. Under the ruling, a malformed expectation refuses that claim alone with GEOSPEC_INVALID_EXPECTATION, keeping the rejection's message and adding the matcher's correction suggestion; details name the field and, when the key occurs once in the payload, its JSONPath from the payload root ($). Sibling claims keep the results profile 01 pins for them alone. A canonical plan carries the malformed payload as supplied. Errors in the envelope, limits, subjects, slots, budgets and polarity still reject the plan, so a never-ingested subject now outranks the claim's refusal.
authority.scope: This overlay supersedes exactly the records listed below, after current-profile-02 is applied; the current-profile-03 records are disjoint. outcome names the rule each record follows. Single toHave* claims are pinned in both polarities, because a refusal holds under either; queries, batches and subject-first records are pinned positive only.
